scope: Existing Stage1 Wind Cave only; no room, gameplay, collision-policy or source-layout changes.

generator.method: Original closed native profile extrusion, vertices and miters preserved. Each chunk separates actual inner faces from ridge/exposed faces. Upright inner metric UVs and normal-aware world-metre outer rock mapping; no source image or physics edits. Exact emitted cross-sections are retained as read-only wall-attachment metadata; no rock vertex or triangle is changed.

material.normal_source: Actual geometry face normals; no normal-map asset
material.limitation: Existing generated albedo retains its authored micro self-shading; not a PBR scan.
material.uv: Explicit face UV: horizontal native X or Z /2.6; vertical native Y /2.6. No triplanar mixing or second material UV scale.

geometry.actual_runtime_counts: native_cave_geometry가 원래 경계 수와 모델 수의 일치·닫힌 삼각형·2재질·예산을 검사한다.
geometry.material_boundary: Original PROFILE[4] ridge; inner faces0–3, exposed faces4–7. Positions/triangle winding/camera/physics unchanged.
geometry.grouping: 원래 연결된 직선 벽 구간마다 하나의 가림 오브젝트; 안쪽/바깥쪽 두 재질을 함께 투명화한다.

replacement.source_nodes: Preserved as hidden rules/art adapters; no ancestor-visibility gating.

lighting.outdoor_settings: Captured on entry, restored exactly on exit.
lighting.lamp_mount: Existing ten lights follow enlarged wall torches at actual inner-wall triangle contacts; no additional local light or shadow pass.

validation.headless: native_cave_geometry와 cave_treasure가 기하·출처·실제 플레이어 시선 가림/복원·몬스터 제외를 검사한다.
validation.gpu: 입구·방·갈림길의 실제 가로/세로 화면을 확인한다. 일회성 캡처는 build/에 둔다.

outer_material.uv: World-space triplanar XYZ/3.2m follows actual geometry normals at steep shoulders and corner tapers. Baked fallback UVs remain finite; no geometry stretch.

floor_shader.method: Shared lit slab shader; original2.6m UV and pixels, reduced albedo contrast/detail0.68 and a warm neutral base. No emission, normal-map fabrication or light changes.
